chinese: 在全国各地的许多学校里，
english: cross the country, in many schools,

chinese: 像我们一样的学生都遵守规则！

english: Be on time. Don’t be late for class.

chinese: 遵守规则对我们有好处！
english: Keeping the rules is good for us!
Every day, from Monday to Friday,

chinese: 保持我们的学校干净整洁！
english: Keep our school clean and tidy!

chinese: 发言要举手。走路，不要跑。
english: Raise your hand. Walk and don’t run.

chinese: 遵守规则，让我们过得开心！
english: Keep the rules and let’s have fun!
